questions.question: What is the primary goal of the new regulatory framework introduced by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regarding digital payment security?

options.text: To introduce SMS OTP for all transactions
To mandate Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for all digital payments
To eliminate the need for digital payments in India
To reduce the use of UPI for transactions

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To mandate Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for all digital payments.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced a new regulatory framework that makes Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) mandatory for all digital payments starting April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Starting from April 1, 2026, all digital payments including UPI, net banking, mobile wallets, and card transactions will require Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).**
 
• This will replace the outdated SMS OTP system, making the verification process more secure and less vulnerable to fraud.
 
• The new guidelines will allow flexible authentication methods like biometrics, device-based tokens, passphrases, and app authenticators.
 
• Risk-based authentication may also be applied for high-value or suspicious transactions to enhance security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)__

 __
 
• 2FA is a security process in which the user provides two different authentication factors to verify themselves.
 
• It adds an additional layer of protection to ensure the user is who they claim to be.
 
 
 
• SMS OTP__
 __
 
• SMS OTP is a one-time password sent via text message to verify a transaction.
 
• Although still allowed, the RBI aims to reduce dependence on it due to security vulnerabilities.
 
 
 
• Biometric Authentication__
 __
 
• Biometric authentication includes methods like fingerprint or facial recognition for secure user verification.
 
 
 
• Risk-based Authentication__
 
 
• Risk-based authentication triggers extra layers of verification based on transaction risk levels, such as high-value or cross-border payments.

questions.question: What initiative did the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launch, to test innovative products for its Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Retail Sandbox.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launched a retail sandbox for its Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) on October 8, 2025, to encourage fintech innovation for the e-Rupee retail pilot.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sandbox initiative allows fintech companies to test and deploy new digital payment solutions within a controlled environment.**
 
• **Launched on December 1, 2022, the e-Rupee retail pilot will now be expanded with the sandbox framework to foster innovation and development.**
 
• **India’s e-Rupee, unlike cryptocurrencies, is a regulated digital currency issued by the RBI and holds the same value as physical currency.**
 
• **This move reinforces India's efforts to become a leader in the adoption of digital currencies globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)__

 __
 
• A government-issued digital currency, representing a digital form of national currency, unlike decentralized cryptocurrencies.
 
 
 
• Sandbox Environment__
 __
 
• A secure environment where new technologies, such as digital currencies, can be tested without impacting the broader financial system.
 
 
 
• e-Rupee__
 
 
• India’s official digital currency, issued by RBI, designed to complement the physical currency and serve as a legal tender in digital form.

questions.question: Recently, External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar warned of a rising bioterrorism threat at the 50th anniversary conference of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC). The BWC is built on which of the following international protocols?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer: B) 1925 Geneva Protocol

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

EAM S. Jaishankar called for strengthening global biosecurity at the BWC’s 50th anniversary conference held in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) forms the cornerstone of the global ban on biological and toxin weapons.
 
• The convention is historically rooted in the *1925 Geneva Protocol*, which prohibited the use of chemical and biological weapons during war.
 
• At the conference, India highlighted gaps in the BWC framework — lack of compliance mechanisms, technical bodies, and systems to track new scientific advances.
 
• Jaishankar stressed rising risks from genome editing, synthetic biology, and AI-driven biological design.
 
• He emphasised stronger biosecurity for the Global South and India's contributions in biotechnology, vaccines, labs (BSL-3 & BSL-4), and global health support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The BWC prohibits development, production, acquisition, stockpiling, transfer, and use of biological and toxin weapons.
 
• India is a member of major non-proliferation regimes including the Wassenaar Arrangement, MTCR, and Australia Group.
 
• The 1925 Geneva Protocol was the first international treaty banning chemical and biological weapons in warfare.

questions.question: Which of the following is a key measure proposed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to modernize India’s banking system?

options.text: Introducing a risk-based deposit insurance premium
Lowering capital requirements for all sectors

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Introducing a risk-based deposit insurance premium.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has proposed introducing a risk-based deposit insurance premium to align India's banking system with global standards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The new proposal will see banks with better credit profiles paying lower premiums, while weaker banks will incur higher costs.**
 
• **This shift encourages prudent banking practices, aiming to enhance depositor protection and financial stability in the long term.**
 
• **The risk-based system contrasts with the current flat-rate premium system, where all banks pay the same amount regardless of their risk level.**
 
• **This is one of the key measures introduced by RBI on 1 October 2025 to modernize and strengthen the banking sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Risk-Based Deposit Insurance Premium__

 __
 
• A system where banks with better risk management pay lower premiums, and those with weaker credit profiles pay higher premiums.
 
 
 
• Basel III Norms__
 __
 
• International regulatory framework that defines the capital adequacy standards for banks, including adjustments for specific sectors like MSMEs and housing.
 
 
 
• Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Provisioning__
 
 
• A forward-looking approach to provisioning for credit risks, requiring higher proactive provisioning by banks.

questions.question: What is Bima Sugam, and what is its key objective for India’s insurance sector?

options.text: A regulatory body for the insurance sector in India.
A digital portal for motor insurance only, with a focus on claims and renewals.
A new platform for health insurance comparison and sales.
A one-stop digital marketplace for all types of insurance products aimed at increasing accessibility and transparency.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A one-stop digital marketplace for all types of insurance products aimed at increasing accessibility and transparency.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Bima Sugam is a unified digital platform that allows policyholders to compare, purchase, renew, manage, and claim insurance policies across various sectors including life, health, motor, travel, and more.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The platform will enable stakeholders such as insurers, intermediaries, brokers, and policyholders to interact seamlessly through a digital interface.**
 
• **It covers multiple types of insurance, including life, health, motor, travel, property, and agriculture, making it a comprehensive solution.**
 
• **Bima Sugam aims to increase insurance penetration, improve transparency, and reduce friction in policy servicing, contributing to the government’s vision of "Insurance for All by 2047."**
 
• **The platform is expected to fully enable transactional features by December 2025, focusing on security, compliance, and scalability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Stakeholders**__

 __
 
• The platform is overseen by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and operated by the Bima Sugam India Federation (BSIF).
 
 
 
• **Strategic Benefits**__
 __
 
• Bima Sugam is a major step in India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) efforts, aiming to make insurance accessible to underserved populations, especially in rural areas.
 
• The platform will increase consumer trust by ensuring transparency in policy comparison and direct interaction with insurers.
 
 
 
• **Expected Full Launch**__
 
 
• The platform is set to be fully transactional by December 2025, streamlining functions like renewals, claims, and policy management, ultimately reducing costs for both users and insurers.

questions.question: Which drug, manufactured by Eli Lilly and Company, became the highest-value selling drug in India in October 2025, crossing ₹1 billion in monthly sales within months of its launch?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mounjaro.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Eli Lilly and Company’s drug Mounjaro became India’s highest-value selling drug in October 2025, achieving over ₹1 billion in monthly sales within just seven months of launch.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mounjaro** was launched in India in **March 2025** by **Eli Lilly and Company**, a leading global pharmaceutical manufacturer.
 
• The drug recorded **₹1 billion (≈ $11.38 million)** in sales in **October 2025**, and cumulative revenue of ₹3.33 billion up to that point.
 
• Mounjaro is designed for **type-2 diabetes management and weight-loss therapy**, leveraging a dual-hormone mechanism targeting **GLP-1 and GIP receptors.**
 
• Its strong early adoption reflects the growing demand for **anti-obesity and metabolic disorder treatments** in India’s changing healthcare landscape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Mounjaro**__

 __
 
• Generic name: **Tirzepatide**
 
• Mechanism: Acts on **GLP-1 (Glucagon-Like Peptide-1)** and **GIP (Glucose-Dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide)** receptors.
 
• Uses: **Blood sugar control in diabetes** and **medical weight management.**
 
• Initial price in India: ≈ ₹14,000 for a 2.5 mg dose pack.
 
 
 
• **Eli Lilly and Company**__
 __
 
• Founded: 1876
 
• Headquarters: **Indianapolis, Indiana, USA**
 
• Global focus: Endocrinology, oncology, and immunology drugs.
 
 
 
• **Indian Pharma Market Context**__
 __
 
• India’s pharmaceutical sector is among the largest globally by volume.
 
• Mounjaro’s rapid rise shows **market disruption** in chronic care and metabolic treatments.
 
• Its success signals **increasing public interest in obesity and lifestyle-disease management therapies.**
 
 
 
• **Competitor Drug: Wegovy**__
 
 
• Manufactured by **Novo Nordisk** and launched in India in **June 2025**.
 
• By October, Mounjaro’s consumption was **ten times higher** than Wegovy’s.
 
 

76:T1b

questions.question: From which date will it be mandatory for all electric vehicles in India to be equipped with the Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System (AVAS)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**October 1, 2027**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **From October 1, 2027, Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System (AVAS) will become mandatory for all existing electric vehicle models in production in India.**
 
• **Newly launched electric vehicles will need to have AVAS from October 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The AVAS system will enhance road safety by alerting pedestrians and cyclists about the presence of near-silent electric vehicles.**
 
• **The system applies to all electric cars, buses, and trucks in India, aligning with international safety standards.**
 
• **The new regulation aims to reduce the risk of accidents, especially in congested urban areas where EVs can go unnoticed.**
 
• **By October 1, 2027, all EVs in production must have AVAS, complying with AIS-173 standards for sound audibility.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Regulating Authority:__ **

 __
 
• **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) is overseeing the implementation of AVAS in India.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Technology:__ **
 __
 
• **The AVAS will emit artificial sounds from electric vehicles to ensure they are detectable by pedestrians and other road users.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Standard:__ **
 
 
• **AVAS must comply with AIS-173 standards for sound audibility.**

questions.question: Which Indian bank has achieved the historic dual milestone of crossing $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business, becoming the first in Indian banking history to do so?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The State Bank of India (SBI) has achieved a historic dual milestone by crossing $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business, making it the first Indian bank ever to reach this scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• SBI’s market capitalisation crossed $100 billion following a strong rise in share price after impressive Q2 FY26 earnings.
 
• The bank’s total business, combining advances and deposits, has exceeded ₹100 trillion (₹100 lakh crore)—a first in Indian banking history.
 
• Total advances stand at approximately ₹44.2 lakh crore, while deposits total around ₹55.9 lakh crore.
 
• This milestone reflects SBI’s strong growth in retail, SME, and corporate lending and its pivotal role in India’s economic expansion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Growth Drivers**__

 __
 
• Credit Growth: 12.7% year-on-year, led by retail, SME, and agricultural lending.
 
• Digital Expansion: Digital lending initiatives and festive demand boosted performance.
 
• Financial Performance: 10% rise in net profit during Q2 FY26 and improved asset quality.
 
• Investor Confidence: Improved margins, stable outlook, and cost-efficiency attracted more investors.
 
 
 
• **SBI’s Market Standing**__
 __
 
• Now part of the global $100 billion market-cap club alongside Reliance Industries and TCS.
 
• Recognised as India’s largest and most systemically important public sector bank.
 
 
 
• **Static Facts**__
 __
 
• Founded: July 1, 1955 (originated from the Imperial Bank of India)
 
• Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 
• Chairman: Challa Sreenivasulu Setty
 
• Total Branches: Over 22,000 across India
 
• Status: Classified as a Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB)
 
 
 
• **Global Significance**__
 
 
• This dual milestone strengthens India’s position in the global banking ecosystem.
 
• Highlights the resilience and scalability of India’s public sector banking model.
 
• Marks SBI’s evolution into a global contender in retail and digital banking innovation.
 
 

80:T1b6d

questions.question: Which sector registered the highest growth in August 2025 according to the Index of Eight Core Industries (ICI)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Steel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India’s industrial performance saw a strong 6.3% growth in August 2025, led by improvements in key sectors like steel, coal, cement, and fertilizers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The steel sector led with a growth of 14.2% in August 2025, marking the highest growth among all sectors.**
 
• **Steel’s cumulative growth for the period April–August 2025–26 was 10.4%, driven by increased demand from infrastructure projects.**
 
• **Steel plays a significant role in India’s industrial landscape, accounting for 17.92% of the Index of Eight Core Industries (ICI).**
 
• **The growth in steel indicates a recovery in construction, road, and real estate sectors, following government initiatives to boost infrastructure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Index of Eight Core Industries (ICI)__ **

 __
 
• **Introduced in 2004-05, it measures the performance of critical industries like coal, steel, cement, and electricity.**
 
 
 
• **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)__ **
 __
 
• **Tracks the overall industrial output, of which ICI contributes over 40%.**
 
 
 
• **Cumulative Growth__ **
 __
 
• **Represents the total growth for a given period, such as April–August, 2025-26, for various sectors.**
 
 
 
• **Steel’s Role__ **
 
 
• **With a weight of 17.92% in ICI, steel is a key component of India’s industrial and infrastructure development.**
